title: I asked AI for a joke 1,008 times 😐

beats.say: I asked AI to tell me a joke.
Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything.

beats.sub: you know where this is going

beats.say: Researchers actually tested this. They asked ChatGPT for a joke one thousand and eight times.
Over ninety percent were the same twenty five jokes.
Number one? The scarecrow who won an award for being outstanding in his field. A hundred and forty times.

beats.sub: per the 2023 study by Jentzsch and Kersting
beats.say: The study found the AI mostly wasn't inventing jokes. It was reciting ones it had memorized.
Follow for more things the algorithm did.
